item.title: Refactor orders crate: order status string to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type, with observable behaviour unchanged.

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit the work; commit and push nothing else, and use no git identity overrides.

pr.body: Adds src/status.rs with OrderStatus (Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled): as_str, Display, FromStr returning ParseStatusError, and can_transition_to encoding pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled. Order::status is now OrderStatus; billing::pay, shipping::ship and Order::cancel use can_transition_to with the same error texts as before. report::status_counts returns Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)> still sorted by status name (BTreeMap keyed by as_str). from_line keeps its 'unknown status' error text. Status literals live only in src/status.rs. Checks: fmt clean, clippy clean with -D warnings, cargo test 5 passed (baseline 3). Assumption: no downstream crates depend on Order::status being a String; public API break noted.
pr.summary: made order status a typed enum. now can match and transition statuses at compile time. before: String compared to literals, now: OrderStatus with can_transition_to; report output unchanged.
pr.title: Replace order status strings with OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Public API type change: Order::status and report::status_counts change from String to OrderStatus, so downstream callers break at compile time. Behaviour verified unchanged for reachable transitions and output; tests run and passing; one reviewer found no blocking issues.
